note: Analysis only, never shown to a model. One entry per physical mechanism in explore/handbook.md (titles verbatim). 'templates' = template names in atmoscoder_rl.templates (original 30 + extended 23); 'traps' = test-side regime:recognise traps (family(t) == 'regime:recognise', parent not in split 'train'). An entry with no template or trap would be a pure distractor; there are none.

mapping_notes.trap_3.8_gen: mapped to the vertical-path entry; the key takes the layer's pressure difference as p*dz/H, which the entry states as the thin-layer/characteristic-pressure form. The trap's physics is the least clear of the 40; review.
mapping_notes.trap_holton_28_gen: inertial-circle motion of two objects on a rotating plane; covered by the inertial-oscillation entry (circle radius V/f), not by a dedicated formula for the miss distance.
mapping_notes.trap_5.9_gen: damped inertial oscillation after friction changes; the entry states that the oscillation is about the NEW steady state, amplitude = difference of the two steady winds.
mapping_notes.trap_ry_14.2_p11: glaciation with the vapour relaxing past ice saturation (sign reversal); covered by the latent-heating entry.
mapping_notes.trap_13.5_gen / trap_jacob_13.1_gen: flagged magnitude_defect upstream (not 'sound'); mapped anyway because they are in the regime:recognise test set.
mapping_notes.nonsteady_burden / mixed_layer_response: merged: the same first-order relaxation toward an equilibrium value.
mapping_notes.cstr_vs_pfr / trap_ca_5.3_gen: merged: removal efficiency depends on the mixing state (well-mixed vs plug flow; turbulent vs laminar collector).
mapping_notes.plume_ground_reflection / plume_mixing_l: merged: image sources at the ground and at the lid.
